releaseMode: single consolidated release; nothing reaches main until all stages pass

stages.name: Exam interaction stability
work: Eliminate broad DOM observer loops in exam, draft and family-management enhancements.
Use explicit draft-restored signaling and idempotent score-mode synchronization.
Regression-test opening, restoring draft, typing, scrolling, closing and reopening the exam dialog without callback storms.

stages.name: Trajectory-first multi-exam analysis
work: Treat rank/percentile trajectory as primary and raw score as supporting evidence.
For 2+ exams show latest-vs-previous movement, recent trend, subject contributors and comparable-data caveats.
Do not fake percentile when participant counts are missing; rank-only comparisons remain rank-only.
Separate single-exam share from trajectory share so users deliberately choose what story is being shared.
Trajectory share must make multiple exams visually comparable rather than merely list records.

stages.name: Independent-family invitation and recovery
work: Only the designated bootstrap/owner account can issue one-time independent-family invitations by default.
Invitation is high-entropy, one-time, expiring, and creates a completely separate family/member/student namespace.
New family owner sets their own username/password; inviter cannot read that family's grades or private data.
Issue a one-time recovery code after account creation; store only its hash.
Forgot-password supports username + recovery code and rotates the recovery code while revoking old sessions.
If recovery code is lost, inviter can issue a short-lived one-time password-reset link without learning old/new password.
Record minimal security audit metadata for invitation/recovery issuance and consumption.

stages.name: Full release gate
work: Bump package, lockfile and Worker APP_VERSION to 0.2.0.
Run syntax, unit, integration, security and UI-contract regression tests.
Review final PR diff for secrets/privacy/data isolation/performance regressions.
Mark Ready only when all checks are green, merge with expected head SHA, run main CI, Cloudflare deploy and production health attestation for 0.2.0.

resumeRule: Resume from the latest open v0.2.0 PR head and this file. Do not merge a partially completed stage. The old PR #9 is closed and its hotfix commits are already inherited into this branch.
